name: MACHO
summary: Historical dedicated survey searching stellar microlensing for compact dark objects in the Galactic halo. The project name MACHO must be distinguished from the generic candidate objects called MACHOs.
detection_principle: Monitors many stellar light curves for transient brightening from foreground compact-object lensing, using event rates and durations to estimate masses and halo contributions.

status.label: Data taking ended / historical experiment
status.evidence: LLNL presents the project retrospectively. This dossier archives the original survey rather than an instrument presumed still operating.

collaboration.name: MACHO collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Only examples of lead or participating institutions directly established by the sources are listed. This is not a complete collaboration list, and listing does not imply equal institutional roles.

results.summary: Under specific halo models, the LMC sample supported a partial compact-object contribution; it did not identify all dark matter.

science_scope: Constrains dark-matter distribution and properties through gravity, microlensing or structure statistics; does not directly identify dark-matter particles.
